content_of_post_to_answer: How can you tell if a habit is actually improving your life or just making you feel productive?
answer: A useful test is to look beyond the feeling of progress and examine what the habit changes when nobody is watching. A habit that improves your life usually creates evidence: better decisions, more capacity, stronger relationships, or meaningful results. A productivity-feeling habit often only creates the comfort of being busy. The tricky part is that both can feel disciplined; the difference is whether the habit is serving your goals or protecting you from harder work.
